glossary.aporte: contribution (domain); the server/aportes directory became commands
glossary.arreglo: fix (an upstream umu-protonfixes fix); array (elementosDeArreglo, a JSON array in server/external/protondb.ts)
glossary.aviso: warning (GPU); notice (form message); listener (a store callback in ui/progress.ts)
glossary.camino: render path (graphics); path (RutaJuego.camino, the chosen render path; a Schema issue path in ui/useAction.ts)
glossary.ejemplo: sample (demo data); demo (SelloEjemplo, the demo-data stamp)
glossary.entorno: setup (a tested environment); env (a shell variable)
glossary.entrada: input; sign in (Entrada, the sign-in form schema in routes/-account.ts, from entrar)
glossary.estado: status (domain); state (UI state such as CopyBox and useState pairs)
glossary.fallo: failure (a game compatibility failure); error (Respuesta.fallo, a reply that failed; FalloDominio is DomainError)
glossary.ficha: game page; page (tests); SampleCard (the dev-only /_muestras gallery)
glossary.largo: max length; tooLong and oversized (test inputs past a limit)
glossary.motivo: reason; motif (a cover-art pattern in ui/cover-art.ts)
glossary.origen: origin (contributions.ts, server/origin.ts); source (ReporteOrigen and FalloOrigen in form-options.ts, the report a solution answers)
glossary.prueba: test (one approved test run); approved and context (test fixture locals)
glossary.ruta: path (a graphics path to the GPU); route (idDeRuta, a router path param)
glossary.salida: kernel (distros: the kernel line a Kepler card stays on); spans (codificarTramos in server/gpu/ranges.ts); output (script output in detector.test.ts)
glossary.como: via (distros); asUser and asGuest (test helpers that act as a session)
glossary.accion: action (runAction runs a write in a transaction)
glossary.crear: create; sign up (CrearCuenta, the sign-up page)
glossary.ejecutar: run (runStatements in migrations; runRead and runAction in server/run.ts; run in useAction; runScript in detector.test.ts)
glossary.elemento: element; item (a review queue item in routes/revision.tsx)
glossary.registrar: submit (a contribution); sign up (registrar in routes/-account.ts, a better-auth account); note (RegistrarArreglo, records a merged PR like noteFix)
glossary.tramo: span (a run of consecutive PCI ids)
glossary.destino: destination; target (Destino in diagnostico/importar.tsx, where a diagnostic is saved)
glossary.volver: return to (the search key volver stays)
